owner_decision.statement: OD-S15-02 as amended by OD-S15-03 requires one final 1.5.0 candidate after CTG9, with no further release candidates or intermediate pull requests. RC2 (1.5.0-rc.2) was published for all 44 packages from 137ff2b308d6399b94c34df478ebdce259925b76 in workflow run 36356692969. The 1.5.0-rc.3 version on the STYNX workspace and origin/main was not published; the last published RC remains 1.5.0-rc.2. The next unified publication candidate is exactly stable 1.5.0 for the complete 44-package fixed release unit. Publish only with the latest dist-tag and an action-specific exact-main-SHA Owner receipt; preflight latest must remain 1.4.0 and rc must remain 1.5.0-rc.2 until publication. This decision does not authorize angular-profile 2.0.0 remediation.

anomalies.rationale: The Owner adjudicated 2.0.0 as an incorrect major assignment rather than a canonical STYNX 2.x decision.
anomalies.closure_condition: Unified stable 1.5.0 is verified for all 44 publishable packages, latest resolves to 1.5.0, rc remains at 1.5.0-rc.2, and angular-profile 2.0.0 remains immutable non-canonical history.
